steps.title: Tell us what the roof is doing
steps.desc: Pick the damage type, your roof size, and how urgent it is. Takes under a minute — no account, no sign-up, works on any phone.

steps.title: See repair vs. replacement
steps.desc: An honest range built on Design Roofing's own pricing — patch it when a patch will hold, replace it when it won't. Same answer we'd give you on the roof.

steps.title: Get a free inspection on the calendar
steps.desc: Pick a slot and a Design Roofing crew leader comes out, documents the damage in writing, and gives you a firm scope and price. No obligation.

bookingSub: Pick a slot and we'll come out, get up on the roof, document what's actually damaged, and hand you a written scope — no obligation, no pressure.
